introduction: Tennessee LIHEAP is administered through county-serving agencies, with a THDA online intake route. Confirm the current application period before submitting.
description: Tennessee LIHEAP is administered through county-serving agencies, with a THDA online intake route. Confirm the current application period before submitting.

sections.who: The provider reviews household income and energy circumstances under current program rules.
sections.get: Approved payments go to the utility or energy supplier rather than the applicant.
sections.docs:
• Household income information.
  • Utility account and energy-cost records.
  • Any shutoff notice and requested identity evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Locate current intake

    Use THDA’s application and county-provider links.

  2. Confirm the current period

    Ask the county agency which application and funding window applies now.

  3. Submit the checklist

    Keep confirmation and answer the provider’s verification requests.
sections.after: Contact the utility while waiting and raise an urgent disconnection with local intake.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using THDA LIHEAP intake and payments, Federal Tennessee intake directory. USA Assistance background guide. The linked provider must confirm current eligibility and intake arrangements.

faqs: THDA describes payment through the agency to the utility or supplier.
Who can help with an online form?
THDA identifies the agency serving your county for application assistance.
Why should I check the period?
The accessible guidance describes the 2025–26 opening; current 2026–27 intake needs confirmation.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
blockers: THDA page inaccessible to direct opening. Indexed primary guidance confirms online/local intake and supplier payments but current 2026–27 enrollment and eligibility detail were not retrievable.
